India's other green clearances — Forest, Wildlife & CRZ

The same open PARIVESH API that serves Environmental Clearances serves three more central clearances. Together they are the full green-clearance funnel a project passes through — and Forest Clearance carries something EC does not: the actual area of land, in hectares. ← back to EC sub-sector analysis

Forest Clearance is a second land-creation channel

Every Environmental Clearance answers "may this project pollute?"; Forest Clearance answers "may this project take this forest land?" — so it is the one register that measures land quantum. Of the 1.05 million ha in the pipeline (inflated by delisted applications and one ~74,000-ha outlier), the trustworthy figure is the forest land with final diversion orders granted:

For scale: the entire national industrial land bank shows ~253,720 developed-and-vacant acres. Forest diversion adds ~381,156 more acres of granted land-use change — a different channel (mining, linear infra, hydro), on a different clock.

What the three funnels say

Forest (38.5% of decided granted) — 88% are fresh Form-A diversions, but 40% of the register is auto-delisted, so the live decided pool is smaller than the headline count. Wildlife (45.1% granted) is the real bottleneck: 39 of 120 sit in process, most "Pending at Proponent" — projects near protected areas stall here for the National/State Board for Wildlife recommendation. CRZ (62.2%) is small and coastal (7 states/UTs) — the gate for ports, coastal industry and waterfront projects.

Source — PARIVESH 2.0 open API (advanceSearchData?majorClearanceType=2|3|4), full Forest / Wildlife / CRZ registers, fetched 2026-11-02. Grant rate = granted ÷ (granted + in-process); 'dead' (rejected/withdrawn/returned) and 'delisted' (PARIVESH auto-cleanup) are excluded from the denominator, as in the EC analysis. FC 'granted' = "Final Diversion Order Issued" or "Stage-II Accorded"; Stage-I in-principle is not counted. The forest-area pipeline total mixes all statuses and is skewed by a single ~74,000-ha outlier — the granted figure is the reliable one. Pipeline snapshot, not a time series. Data + refresh: github.com/herrrickshaw/india-ec-subsector-analysis. Corrections are displayed, never silent.
